closure_reason: The research objective was misaligned: an Overnight/open predictor should not be judged by the full 09:35-to-15:00 index return because most same-day close variation is generated by post-open information outside the Overnight model's causal scope.
successor_direction: Overnight factor-product / factor-adapter program; validate incremental information at the opening and short post-open horizons rather than forcing a standalone full-day strategy.
